39
Which statement about chlorine gas is correct?
A
It bleaches damp blue litmus paper.
B
It turns damp red litmus paper blue.
It decolourises acidified aqueous potassium manganate(VII).
C
D
It turns limewater cloudy.

options.label: A
options.text: It bleaches damp blue litmus paper.

options.label: B
options.text: It turns damp red litmus paper blue.

options.label: C
options.text: It decolourises acidified aqueous potassium manganate(VII).
